faq.q: What is a monthly content shoot?
faq.a: One planned photo and video session each month that gives a business fresh, real content for its website, Google profile and social media.

faq.q: How much is a monthly content shoot in the UK?
faq.a: One-off shoots usually cost £300 to £1,500. ContentFellow's Studio Fellow is £149 a month for one shoot of up to 3 hours with photo, 4K video and 20 edited photos.

faq.q: Who can film content for my business every month?
faq.a: A local photographer or videographer, a content agency, or a monthly plan such as the Studio Fellow, which shoots on-site across Burnley and East Lancashire.
Yes. The Studio Fellow starts with a free mini shoot.

faq.q: Do I own the photos and videos?
faq.a: Yes, you can use them on your website, social media and ads.
